question: What is said to be hard to obtain even by the gods?
premises: pṛṣṭaḥ aham states the speaker was asked
sura durlabham states hard to obtain by gods
inference: The asked-about matter is hard to obtain even by the gods.
uncertainties: the exact matter asked about is not named in this verse
plain_english: Well, well, O great goddess; I was asked about something hard to obtain even by the gods.
